text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Delicious! It's so good! Yeah, buying this 
was definitely the right call!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what is with that mountain of bread 
all over the bed...?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I just suddenly had this huge craving for 
bread! And then destiny told me, "Let's 
eat everything they have," so... I bought 
out the whole store!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Buying strange things again, I see... I 
don't care what you worship, but—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Just make sure that whatever you buy 
doesn't infringe on my territory... Tell 
that to this "destiny" of yours, will you?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's do that! Oh, right, Ruler, 
want some too? It's delicious and fun!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Fun...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, when you eat, you get to enter a 
lottery on your smartphone. It's really 
exciting and fun!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, a sweepstakes campaign, huh...? 'Scan 
the code on the bag and try your luck at 
the scratcher!' ...I see."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I'll pass. Games of pure chance do 
nothing to stimulate my intellectual 
curiosity."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? The pictures matched up. I see, a 
jackpot! Yes, the voice of destiny told me 
as much!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, another match! It's 3rd prize this 
time! Look, Ruler! I got a cute wallpaper!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(............ No, it was just a fluke, a 
fluke.)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they matched again! Aha, this time 
it's second prize!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(............ A fluke... Yes, this is just 
a game of pure luck...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Like hell that's true~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely strange... Checking social 
media, it's not like this giveaway is just 
handing out prizes left and right...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Is it sheer dumb luck? The occult? No, 
there has to be some kind of trick to 
it...! Epi, show me your winning history!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...! The logs here and here— The resulting 
sequence of numbers matches perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that the number arrangements 
on these scratch-offs are categorized into 
a few set patterns...?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You unconsciously memorized the pattern 
and intuitively "saw through" the winning 
spot— That's what happened, right?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I was just whittling down wherever 
felt right, but...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If my wise Ruler says so, then it must be 
true! You're amazing, understanding things 
about me that even I didn't understand!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...It's nothing. A feat of this level is 
trivial as long as one possesses logical 
thinking.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
However, this just got a whole lot more 
interesting! If I increase the number of 
attempts with these scratch cards, it 
won't be a game of pure luck anymore!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I can dominate with my 
intellect— and establish a surefire 
winning formula!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I'll be able to win any 
prize I want?! That sounds fun! Destiny 
agrees with me!

Just as I was about to eat the bread I 
bought at the school store for lunch, 
Rulership and the others called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ho, Trainer... having school store bread 
today? They're running a campaign for that 
right now, aren't they?
choice_data_list:
Huh? Ah, apparently there's some raffle 
you can draw.

Huh? Ah, apparently there's some raffle 
you can draw.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh, let me... guess.

text_block_list.name: Scratching Sound
text_block_list.text: "2nd Prize, a big winner~~!!"
choice_data_list: Amazing! How did you do that...?!
Amazing! How did you do that...?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ruler worked hard with both her brain and 
body! She was truly amazing!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Eating bread and drawing fortunes together 
with me, comparing the voice of my destiny 
with the fortune results while groaning 
over them—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, stop it! Don't spill that kind of 
stuff! You're ruining my badass aura 
here...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*ahem*—Well, with a little brainpower, 
even "luck-based games" can be 
dominated... That is all.

Apparently, this stunt is the result of 
Rulership's trial and error together with 
Epiphaneia. I can't help but be genuinely 
impressed.
choice_data_list: You two make a great pair as roommates.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Nah, if anything, I usually just think of 
her as "that person who talks about 
destiny and stuff I don't get, and keeps 
trying to drag me outside for no good 
reason," but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well... She's definitely a roommate who 
keeps things exciting.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If it weren't for Epi, I wouldn't have 
even dreamed of trying to take control of 
"games of chance."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I have lots of fun sharing a room 
with Ruler, too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Because you always find fun things I 
never would've noticed and share them with 
me!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I didn't mean it in such an 
emotional way, though... You're throwing 
me off pace."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If we're talking about this time alone, 
that's certainly true. You could say we 
devised this 'sure-win strategy' thanks to 
that 'voice of destiny' Epi talks about.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. I believe you have one 
more scratch card left? Allow me to win it 
for you with my "surefire method."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
“—This is the first-prize pattern! Nice, 
if I just scratch here according to the 
'winning strategy'...!”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No, not that one. The one next to it. I 
feel like destiny is telling me so.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? No, according to my 'Sure-Win 
Method', it should be here.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Say what you want! I think it's this way! 
I'm sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? You've gotta be kidding me... 
here...? Why say something so unsettling 
right now...? I hate this, destiny makes 
no sense at all...

This "voice of destiny" that Rulership's 
roommate talks about doesn't seem like 
something easily brought under control...
